limitations: No qualifying relationship could be verified completely enough to include. arXiv’s bounded advanced-search pages repeatedly timed out, its API requests were marked non-retryable by the web tool, and the potentially useful WithdrarXiv dataset required gated access. These failures prevented establishment of the complete 2021 cs.LG cohort and therefore make the header-only result inconclusive.
Default-page cases: search-provider queries did not expose a selectable page size, so their ordinary default result pages were used. Some default responses contained more than 20 displayed results.

Evidence is incomplete: no candidate relationship was verified end-to-end across withdrawal status, direct-replacement direction, exact UTC version timestamps, and historical/current replacement titles.
